concerns.text: FR‑002 requires obtaining a binary‑black‑hole population catalog from the official IllustrisTNG/EAGLE releases. The plan falls back to generating a synthetic catalog using a power‑law spin distribution when those releases lack the needed data. This synthetic fallback does not satisfy the Constitution Principle VI requirement that simulation data be sourced directly from the official releases, and it provides a dataset that does not represent the intended cosmological simulations, undermining the scientific validity of the comparison.
